targets.rawSQL: SELECT CAST(from_unixtime((ts_ms / $__interval_ms) * $__interval_ms / 1000.0) AS timestamp) AS time, dst_ip AS metric, approx_percentile(rtt_ms, 0.5) AS value FROM heimdall.samples WHERE device = '$device' AND dt BETWEEN $__rawTimeFrom('yyyy-MM-dd') AND $__rawTimeTo('yyyy-MM-dd') AND ts_ms BETWEEN ${__from} AND ${__to} AND kind = 'icmp' AND service = '$service' AND status = 'ok' GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

SELECT CAST(from_unixtime((ts_ms / $__interval_ms) * $__interval_ms / 1000.0) AS timestamp) AS time, dst_ip AS metric, approx_percentile(rtt_ms, 0.95) AS value FROM heimdall.samples WHERE device = '$device' AND dt BETWEEN $__rawTimeFrom('yyyy-MM-dd') AND $__rawTimeTo('yyyy-MM-dd') AND ts_ms BETWEEN ${__from} AND ${__to} AND kind = 'icmp' AND service = '$service' AND status = 'ok' GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

SELECT CAST(from_unixtime((ts_ms / $__interval_ms) * $__interval_ms / 1000.0) AS timestamp) AS time, dst_ip AS metric, 100.0 * count_if(status <> 'ok') / count(*) AS value FROM heimdall.samples WHERE device = '$device' AND dt BETWEEN $__rawTimeFrom('yyyy-MM-dd') AND $__rawTimeTo('yyyy-MM-dd') AND ts_ms BETWEEN ${__from} AND ${__to} AND kind = 'icmp' AND service = '$service' AND true GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

SELECT CAST(from_unixtime((ts_ms / $__interval_ms) * $__interval_ms / 1000.0) AS timestamp) AS time, dst_ip AS metric, approx_percentile(rtt_ms, 0.5) AS value FROM heimdall.samples WHERE device = '$device' AND dt BETWEEN $__rawTimeFrom('yyyy-MM-dd') AND $__rawTimeTo('yyyy-MM-dd') AND ts_ms BETWEEN ${__from} AND ${__to} AND kind = 'tcp' AND service = '$service' AND status = 'ok' GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: HTTPS phases p50
panels.description: connect and tls are the handshake durations; ttfb and total are measured from the start of the request. TLS much slower than connect points at a TLS-terminating edge or filtering.

targets.rawSQL: SELECT CAST(from_unixtime((ts_ms / $__interval_ms) * $__interval_ms / 1000.0) AS timestamp) AS time, approx_percentile(CAST(json_extract_scalar(extra, '$.connect_ms') AS double), 0.5) AS connect, approx_percentile(CAST(json_extract_scalar(extra, '$.tls_ms') AS double), 0.5) AS tls, approx_percentile(CAST(json_extract_scalar(extra, '$.ttfb_ms') AS double), 0.5) AS ttfb, approx_percentile(CAST(json_extract_scalar(extra, '$.total_ms') AS double), 0.5) AS total FROM heimdall.samples WHERE device = '$device' AND dt BETWEEN $__rawTimeFrom('yyyy-MM-dd') AND $__rawTimeTo('yyyy-MM-dd') AND ts_ms BETWEEN ${__from} AND ${__to} AND kind = 'http' AND status = 'ok' AND service = '$service' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Relative ICMP RTT for services in $category
panels.description: 1.0 is each destination's median over the range. One service rising alone points at its path or its servers.

targets.rawSQL: WITH s AS ( SELECT service AS metric, service, dst_ip, CAST(from_unixtime((ts_ms / $__interval_ms) * $__interval_ms / 1000.0) AS timestamp) AS time, rtt_ms FROM heimdall.samples WHERE device = '$device' AND dt BETWEEN $__rawTimeFrom('yyyy-MM-dd') AND $__rawTimeTo('yyyy-MM-dd') AND ts_ms BETWEEN ${__from} AND ${__to} AND kind = 'icmp' AND status = 'ok' AND category = '$category' ), b AS (SELECT service, dst_ip, approx_percentile(rtt_ms, 0.5) AS base FROM s GROUP BY 1, 2) SELECT s.time, s.metric, approx_percentile(s.rtt_ms / b.base, 0.5) AS value FROM s JOIN b ON s.service = b.service AND s.dst_ip = b.dst_ip WHERE b.base > 0 GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: HTTPS edges
panels.description: Where each destination terminated the HTTPS request, from the response headers.

targets.rawSQL: SELECT target_id, dst_ip, json_extract_scalar(extra, '$.cdn') AS cdn, json_extract_scalar(extra, '$.pop') AS pop, json_extract_scalar(extra, '$.proto') AS proto, json_extract_scalar(extra, '$.kex') AS kex, count(*) AS requests, approx_percentile(CAST(json_extract_scalar(extra, '$.tls_ms') AS double), 0.5) AS tls_p50, approx_percentile(CAST(json_extract_scalar(extra, '$.ttfb_ms') AS double), 0.5) AS ttfb_p50 FROM heimdall.samples WHERE device = '$device' AND dt BETWEEN $__rawTimeFrom('yyyy-MM-dd') AND $__rawTimeTo('yyyy-MM-dd') AND ts_ms BETWEEN ${__from} AND ${__to} AND kind = 'http' AND status = 'ok' AND service = '$service' GROUP BY 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6 ORDER BY requests DESC

panels.title: HTTPS and TCP failures
panels.description: A TLS-phase timeout or reset after a successful connect is typical of SNI filtering.

targets.rawSQL: SELECT CAST(from_unixtime(ts_ms / 1000.0) AS timestamp) AS time, kind, target_id, dst_ip, status, json_extract_scalar(extra, '$.phase') AS phase, json_extract_scalar(extra, '$.reason') AS reason, json_extract_scalar(extra, '$.code') AS code, CAST(json_extract_scalar(extra, '$.connect_ms') AS double) AS connect_ms FROM heimdall.samples WHERE device = '$device' AND dt BETWEEN $__rawTimeFrom('yyyy-MM-dd') AND $__rawTimeTo('yyyy-MM-dd') AND ts_ms BETWEEN ${__from} AND ${__to} AND kind IN ('http', 'tcp') AND status <> 'ok' AND service = '$service' ORDER BY ts_ms DESC LIMIT 200

SELECT CAST(from_unixtime(ts_ms / 1000.0) AS timestamp) AS time, json_extract_scalar(extra, '$.host') AS host, json_extract_scalar(extra, '$.prev') AS prev, dst_ip AS new_dst, resolver_id, json_array_length(json_extract(extra, '$.answers')) AS answers, CAST(json_extract_scalar(extra, '$.resolve_ms') AS double) AS resolve_ms FROM heimdall.samples WHERE device = '$device' AND dt BETWEEN $__rawTimeFrom('yyyy-MM-dd') AND $__rawTimeTo('yyyy-MM-dd') AND ts_ms BETWEEN ${__from} AND ${__to} AND kind = 'event' AND service = '$service' AND json_extract_scalar(extra, '$.event') = 'dst_change' ORDER BY ts_ms DESC LIMIT 200
